observations.what: Free sign-up was a three-field form (name, email, organization) plus terms checkbox, then a separate password page, with an hCaptcha on each page.
No email verification was required; the account landed directly on a welcome/onboarding page after creating the password.
The onboarding offered a sample-project tour with a clear 'Skip the tour' link, which let me reach Home immediately.
The free plan allows only 1 project, so the 'Making a Podcast' sample project plus My Project leaves no room for separate projects per stakeholder group.
A new project opens with a plain explanation and a '+' menu listing Message Board, To-dos, Docs, Calendar, Chat, Card Table, making it easy to pick tools.
Adding a To-dos tool first shows a rename-the-tool title form and a separate step to open it and add a first to-do, which took several clicks before I could create a task.
Inviting stakeholders, the core of collaboration, requires adding real people by email, which I could not do in a demo.
I tried to finish before checking for verification mail; the server asked me to check mail, and the only email found was an onboarding notification, not a verification.
